provenance: Synthetic DiagramML controls regenerated and saved by the native reference application. These inputs cover initial scoped references, forward dependencies, cycles, aliases, inherited values, wildcard registration and composite-derived coordinates. Text controls use a single A so content overflow is not part of the comparison. Native rejection is detected from replacement of the authored layout by the default layout. Geometry-only initial evaluation plus arrangement is compared; adjustment rules and text fitting are separate stages. Additional independent controls cover ordered child evaluation, live positions versus captured dimensions and derived edges, repeated layout names, and typed composite geometry declarations. Wildcard reservation controls distinguish applying values to children, reserving their names against later declarations, and exposing explicitly declared reference variables. Empty-selection controls cover child/descendant declarations, unmatched names/point types, literal/reference bases, and geometry/font/user variables; their scoped values remain referenceable when no shapes are selected. Selector alias controls verify that norm/nonAsst and asst/nonNorm identify the same scoped variable, including duplicate-base rejection.
